name: Bismark Battleship
description: The battleship Bismarck is a super battleship named after Otto von Bismarck, the iron-blooded prime minister of Germany in the 19th century. It was the most powerful battleship built by Germany during World War II. It once sank the British first battlecruiser "HMS Hood" in one fell swoop. It was one of the largest and most technologically advanced battleships at the time. Its battleship performance was very excellent. Not only was it powerful, had a high rate of fire, and covered a large firepower area, but it could also shoot into the air at high elevation angles. It was the trump card of the German Navy at that time.
